reason: I buy to resell, so I look at landed cost per piece. At 13,000 a kilo plus 5,000 delivery on every order, cheap light items like accessories and beauty bits end up costing almost double, and there's no margin left for my shop.
objection: Shipping per kilo with no bulk rate kills it for small cheap items, and 2 to 3 weeks with only damage refunds is risky when I've promised stock to customers.
would_change_my_mind: A lower per-kilo rate for bulk orders (say 10 kg and up) with a guaranteed delivery date.
